description:
Open the metallographic sample image at `~/Fiji_Data/raw/surface/surface_scan.tif`.

1. Calibrate the image spatially using `Analyze > Set Scale` (2 pixels = 1 µm, Unit: µm).
2. Extract a horizontal intensity line profile across the middle of the image and save as `~/Fiji_Data/results/surface/horizontal_profile.csv`.
3. Extract a vertical intensity line profile across the middle and save as `~/Fiji_Data/results/surface/vertical_profile.csv`.
4. Measure the whole image statistics to calculate surface roughness parameters (where Intensity = Height in nm).
5. Create a text report at `~/Fiji_Data/results/surface/roughness_report.txt` containing the keys: `Ra` (Arithmetic roughness), `Rq` (RMS roughness), `Rz` (Peak-to-valley), `Mean_height`, and `Median_height`.
6. Generate a 3D Surface Plot (`Analyze > Surface Plot`) and save the visualization as `~/Fiji_Data/results/surface/surface_plot_3d.png`.
7. Add a 50 µm scale bar to the original image and save as `~/Fiji_Data/results/surface/annotated_image.png`.
